name: arabic
author: TwinsanityEvolved
description: The game's texts in Arabic: our translation (tools/text/arabic.tsv) drawn right to left with our own Arabic glyphs in the game's lettering style (tools/font). A language pack, not a mod: it is offered as a text language in the game's options and the launcher's Settings whenever it is in the mods folder; the speech is the speech language's. Holds no disc data.
